text: In accordance with Section B.3. of the Terms of Reference of the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee, the Committee will elect a member of the public as Vice-Chair.

The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee: 1. Elected Susan Gapka as Vice-Chair of the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee for a term of office starting on October 14, 2025 and ending on November 14, 2026, and until a successor is appointed.
